children: AEye entered a new At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners to offer up to $50 million of common stock from time to time and, concurrently, mutually terminated its September 12, 2024 ATM agreement with A.G.P. effective upon signing the new program. Sales may occur on The Nasdaq Capital Market or through other permitted methods, with A.G.P. earning up to a 3.0% commission and Craig-Hallum advising for up to 1.0% per sale. Proceeds will support working capital and growth, including R&D, commercial expansion, capital expenditures, and G&A.
